meta.subject: fixed gpr_ram bug + io bus arbitration

en.summary: This mixed RTL commit contains a clearer and more portable top-level I/O arbitration bug than the first-pass entry captured. Before the fix, multi-core and multi-cluster I/O traffic was effectively hard-wired to source 0, so nonzero sources could not issue or retire MMIO traffic correctly.
why_it_counts: The patch rewires real DUT top-level I/O request and response paths, not test scaffolding.
Old Vortex_Cluster and Vortex_Socket code forwarded only per_core/per_cluster_io_*[0] to the external I/O port.
The fix introduces VX_mem_arb and proper per-source ready/response demultiplexing.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes a separate VX_gpr_ram fix and AFU/scope-related changes.
evidence: Pre-fix Vortex_Cluster.v assigns io_req_* and io_rsp_ready directly from per_core_io_*[0].
Pre-fix Vortex_Socket.v likewise assigns io_req_* and io_rsp_ready directly from per_cluster_io_*[0].
The commit adds a new VX_mem_arb module and instantiates it in both Vortex_Cluster.v and Vortex_Socket.v.
The patched cluster/socket code adds per-source io_req_ready and io_rsp_valid/io_rsp_tag/io_rsp_data wiring instead of broadcasting one shared path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When multiple cores or clusters share one MMIO or I/O fabric port, the top level must arbitrate requests and demultiplex responses back to the originating source. If the integration simply hard-wires the external port to source 0, all other sources lose access or receive no matching responses, producing hangs or incorrect I/O-visible behavior.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: multi-source MMIO or I/O port arbitration
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A nonzero core, warp group, cluster, or tile attempts an MMIO or other I/O transaction through a shared external port.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Bypass the arbitration layer and wire the shared I/O port directly to source 0 while leaving the other sources disconnected from request or response routing.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: hard-wire shared port to first requester
portability_notes: Apply this to any top-level interconnect where multiple internal requesters share one off-core I/O port.
The bug is about integration wiring and response routing, not about the semantics of the MMIO target itself.
If the target DUT already has an arbiter, remove or bypass only the arbitration and response-demux layer.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the point where multiple internal I/O request sources converge onto one external MMIO or device interface.
Remove the arbiter or mux logic and connect the shared output only to requester 0.
Likewise route the shared response or ready signal back only to requester 0.
Keep the rest of the I/O datapath intact so the bug specifically manifests as missing access from nonzero sources.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cluster/socket I/O aggregation onto a shared external port
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces direct [0]-only wiring with a new VX_mem_arb instance and explicit per-source ready/response routing in both Vortex_Cluster and Vortex_Socket.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the VX_mem_arb-based I/O aggregation and restore the old pattern that drives io_req_* and io_rsp_ready from only per_core_io_*[0] or per_cluster_io_*[0].

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: MMIO or other shared-I/O traffic from nonzero sources hangs, never reaches the device, or receives no matching completion, while source 0 may continue to work.
evidence_for_injection: The old code explicitly uses only index 0 for the shared I/O path, making the bug mechanism unambiguous.
The new VX_mem_arb module exists solely to arbitrate and demultiplex that shared path.
This injection is more directly grounded than the first-pass focus on VX_gpr_ram because the interconnect bug is explicit in the diff.
notes: The commit title mentions both gpr_ram and I/O arbitration; this second-pass entry prioritizes the I/O arbitration fix because it is clearer and more reusable for cross-DUT injection.
VX_gpr_ram remains a real touched DUT file, but it is not the primary injection anchor here.

zh.summary: 这个混合 RTL 提交里，比一审记录更清晰、也更可移植的缺陷是顶层 I/O 仲裁错误。修复前，多核/多 cluster 的 I/O 流量实际上被硬连到了 source 0，因此非零来源无法正确发起或完成 MMIO/I/O 事务。
why_it_counts: 补丁重连的是 DUT 顶层真实 I/O 请求与响应路径，而不是测试脚手架。
旧版 Vortex_Cluster 和 Vortex_Socket 都只把 per_core/per_cluster_io_*[0] 转发到外部 I/O 端口。
修复通过引入 VX_mem_arb 以及正确的按来源 ready/response 分发来解决问题。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含独立的 VX_gpr_ram 修复以及 AFU/scope 相关改动。
evidence: 修复前的 Vortex_Cluster.v 直接把 io_req_* 和 io_rsp_ready 连接到 per_core_io_*[0]。
修复前的 Vortex_Socket.v 同样直接把 io_req_* 和 io_rsp_ready 连接到 per_cluster_io_*[0]。
该提交新增了 VX_mem_arb 模块，并在 Vortex_Cluster.v 与 Vortex_Socket.v 中实例化。
修复后的 cluster/socket 代码为每个来源增加了单独的 io_req_ready 和 io_rsp_valid/io_rsp_tag/io_rsp_data 连线，而不再共享一条广播路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 只要多个 core 或 cluster 共用一个 MMIO/I/O 外设端口，顶层就必须对请求进行仲裁，并把响应正确返回给原始来源。如果系统集成层只是把外部端口硬连到来源 0，那么其他来源要么根本发不出请求，要么拿不到对应响应，最终表现为挂起或错误的 I/O 行为。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多来源共享 MMIO/I/O 端口的仲裁
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 非零 core、warp 组、cluster 或 tile 尝试通过共享外设端口发起 MMIO 或其他 I/O 事务。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 绕过仲裁层，把共享 I/O 端口直接连接到来源 0，并让其他来源失去请求或响应回路。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: hard-wire shared port to first requester
portability_notes: 适用于任何多个内部请求方共用一个片外 I/O 端口的顶层互连。
缺陷本质是集成布线和响应回传错误，而不是 MMIO 设备本身的语义问题。
如果目标 DUT 已有仲裁器，只需移除或旁路仲裁与 response-demux 层。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到多个内部 I/O 请求源汇聚到一个外部 MMIO/设备接口的位置。
删掉仲裁器或多路复用逻辑，把共享输出只连接到 requester 0。
把共享响应或 ready 也只回送给 requester 0。
保持其余 I/O 数据通路不变，使故障专门表现为非零来源无法访问。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cluster/socket 到共享外部 I/O 端口的聚合
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 Vortex_Cluster 和 Vortex_Socket 中用 VX_mem_arb 取代了原先只连接 [0] 的写法，并加入了按来源的 ready/response 路由。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 移除基于 VX_mem_arb 的 I/O 聚合，恢复成只用 per_core_io_*[0] 或 per_cluster_io_*[0] 驱动 io_req_* 和 io_rsp_ready 的旧模式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 来自非零来源的 MMIO 或共享 I/O 事务会挂起、无法到达设备，或者没有匹配的完成响应，而来源 0 仍可能正常工作。
evidence_for_injection: 旧代码在共享 I/O 路径上显式只使用 index 0，因此缺陷机理非常明确。
新增的 VX_mem_arb 模块正是为了解决这一条共享路径的仲裁和回传问题。
与一审聚焦 VX_gpr_ram 相比，这个互连缺陷在 diff 里更直接、更适合作为可移植注入目标。
notes: 虽然标题同时提到 gpr_ram 和 I/O arbitration，但二审优先保留 I/O 仲裁修复，因为它更清晰，也更适合跨 DUT 注入。
VX_gpr_ram 仍是这次提交里真实改到的 DUT 文件，但不是本条目的主要注入锚点。
